red_kills: The Growth Illusion: Customer count flat at ~20.4M since 2023; +7.1% YoY revenue growth manufactured via ARPU price hikes on captive SMB base.
AI Disintermediation: AI website builders (Wix AI, Shopify Magic, Vercel/Cursor) invert top-of-funnel domain-first discovery flow.
Capital Structure Fragility: -$3.7B negative book equity; $3.84B debt vs $1.2B cash ($2.64B net debt).
blue_findings: Overturned Customer Count Kill: Domain renewals are an inelastic 'digital real estate tax' (>90% 3-year customer retention) generating $1.205B in real FCF.
Overturned AI Disintermediation: GoDaddy owns primary registrar and DNS infrastructure that every web app/domain must resolve through.
Overturned Capital Structure Kill: Negative book equity is an artifact of treasury buybacks; net leverage is only 1.9x EBITDA with $1.2B annual FCF capable of extinguishing net debt in 24 months.
gates: Add-gate: Applications & Commerce (A&C) segment sustaining double-digit growth.
